templates.pat: Data intensive science for {{1}}
templates.zh: 面向{{1}}的数据密集型科学

templates.pat: Missing something?{{1}} {{2}}

The {{1}} contains the terminology, acronyms and definitions. As a newbie, you will probably skim through this list, but later on in your journey you may come back to refer to it as it will help you get a better understanding of the Galaxy Ecosystem.
templates.zh: {{1}}收录了术语、缩写与定义。作为新手，你可能会先浏览一遍；但在之后的学习中，你可能会回来查阅，因为它能帮助你更好地理解 Galaxy 生态。

templates.pat: Below you will find a {{1}} for you to follow as a newcomer, a student, an expert or just about anybody interested in using Galaxy.
templates.zh: 下面是一份{{1}}，无论你是新手、学生、专家，还是任何对使用 Galaxy 感兴趣的人，都可以照着它走。

templates.pat: The easiest way to be able to follow our tutorials and learn first-hand about Galaxy is by using a{{1}}. We recommend using one of these:
templates.zh: 要跟着我们的教程学习、亲身了解 Galaxy，最简单的方式是使用{{1}}。我们推荐从以下之一开始：

templates.pat: This curated table will take you through the basics of Galaxy. You can choose any tutorial in a variety of formats: {{1}} and {{2}} tutorials are more text-based while {{3}} and {{4}} are more visual-based.
templates.zh: 这张精选表格会带你了解 Galaxy 的基础。你可以选择各种形式的教程：{{1}}和{{2}}教程偏重文字，而{{3}}和{{4}}偏重视觉。

templates.pat: Before diving into Galaxy tutorials, you may check {{1}} and see if there are any upcoming Galaxy Training events you could join. It is often easier and fun to learn together!
templates.zh: 在开始 Galaxy 教程之前，你可以查看{{1}}，看看是否有即将举办、可以参加的 Galaxy 培训活动。一起学习往往更轻松也更有趣！

templates.pat: We have many more {{1}}! The Galaxy Training Network has a great list of tutorials on a variety of topics ({{2}}) written and maintained by the world-wide Galaxy Community.
templates.zh: 我们还有更多{{1}}！Galaxy 培训网络提供了一份涵盖多种主题的优秀教程列表（{{2}}），由全球 Galaxy 社区编写与维护。

templates.pat: Have a bug or an error you haven't been able to solve? Do you have a question that you haven't found already answered in the {{1}}?
templates.zh: 遇到了无法解决的缺陷或报错？或者你的问题在{{1}}里还没有答案？

templates.pat: Check our {{1}} for known issues, problems and tips. Galaxy uses {{2}} for tracking down bugs and feature requests, {{3}}.
templates.zh: 请查看我们的{{1}}，了解已知问题、故障与使用技巧。Galaxy 使用{{2}}跟踪缺陷与功能请求，{{3}}。

templates.pat: If you haven't used mailing list before they are simply a list of addresses to which the same information is being sent, just another way to communicate and interact with the Community. See them {{1}} and remember {{2}}.
templates.zh: 如果你以前没用过邮件列表，它其实就是一组地址，相同的信息会发送给这些地址，是与社区交流互动的另一种方式。在{{1}}查看它们，并记住{{2}}。

templates.pat: Check what other members have done in our {{1}} which contains publications that use, reference, implement, and extend Galaxy.
templates.zh: 看看其他成员做了什么：我们的{{1}}收录了使用、引用、实现和扩展 Galaxy 的出版物。

templates.pat: From India to Australia, Japan to France and many more countries {{1}} are a big part of Galaxy. Find ways to contact them, platforms and lots of other useful links.
templates.zh: 从印度到澳大利亚、从日本到法国以及更多国家，{{1}}是 Galaxy 的重要组成部分。你可以在这里找到联系他们的方式、平台以及许多其他实用链接。

templates.pat: Another way communities are formed is by domains such as Proteomics, Transcriptomics, Ecology and Genome annotation to name a few. Most have set up their own {{1}}.
templates.zh: 社区也可以按领域形成，例如蛋白质组学、转录组学、生态学和基因组注释等。多数领域已建立自己的{{1}}。

templates.pat: What if you can't find yourself in these lists of regional and/or community of practice? Galaxy welcomes new communities, please see {{1}} for more.
templates.zh: 如果在这些区域社区和/或实践社区列表中找不到适合自己的怎么办？Galaxy 欢迎新社区，详情请见{{1}}。

templates.pat: Still wonder what the Galaxy Community is about? You already know it, you are already part of it! But let's dive in the complexity of the {{1}}!
templates.zh: 还在想 Galaxy 社区是什么？其实你已经了解它，你已经是其中一员！不过，让我们深入看看{{1}}的丰富构成吧！

templates.pat: Look at our guide on {{1}} and there are many ways to do so: coding, writing and creating tutorials, and answering questions in Matrix or the Help Forum to mention some ways.
templates.zh: 请参阅我们关于{{1}}的指南，贡献方式有很多：写代码、编写和创建教程、在 Matrix 或帮助论坛回答问题等等。

templates.pat: Are you ready & excited to start your own project or community, to contribute to Open Source or to settle into the Galaxy ecosystem? Check out the {{1}}
templates.zh: 你是否准备好并充满热情，想要开启自己的项目或社区、为开源做贡献，或融入 Galaxy 生态？请查看{{1}}

templates.pat: Thanks to a large {{1}}, there is a constantly growing set of tutorials maintained by the {{2}} covering introductory tutorials, various scientific topics, development and administration.
templates.zh: 在众多{{1}}的努力下，{{2}}维护的教程不断增加，涵盖入门教程、各类科学主题、开发与管理。

templates.pat: There are many approaches to learning how to {{1}} Galaxy. The most popular is probably to just dive in and use it.
templates.zh: 学习{{1}} Galaxy 有很多途径，最流行的做法大概就是直接上手使用。

templates.pat: Interested in a particular area within Galaxy? Connect with a {{1}} and look into their Github Project, Matrix channel and Google Drive to look into what they have done, what they're currently working on and what the future holds for each one. Some of the current Working Groups include Tools, Systems and User Interface/User Experience.
templates.zh: 对 Galaxy 中的某个特定领域感兴趣？请联系{{1}}，并通过他们的 GitHub 项目、Matrix 频道和 Google Drive 了解他们做过什么、当前在做什么，以及每个工作组未来的方向。目前的工作组包括工具、系统与用户界面/用户体验等。
